title: Dan Campbell on Kerby Joseph: We're trying to get him back, but he's not ready

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell on Kerby Joseph: We're trying to get him back, but he's not ready
sources.description: The Lions have struggled in the secondary through the first two weeks of the season and part of the reason why they're having a hard time is the absence of safeties Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph.
